pieces.file: Kick Drum ↔ Foundation — rich — who was there first.m4a
pieces.title: Who was there first
pieces.caption: The same four bars mixed twice. First the chords and bass are set and the kick is squeezed in last, thin. Then the kick goes in first, whole, and the bass steps back each time it speaks. *What is real and what is a choice:* One arrangement, two orders of decision, both synthesized here. The picture shows only what is below 140 Hz. *Leaking in:* Sidechain ↔ Conversation: the bass ducking is that bridge at work.
